tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (395)༄༅/ /klong sde rdo rje zam pa las sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyas pa'i cho ga khrigs su bkod pa ye shes chu rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so/
(395)༄༅/ /klong sde rdo rje zam pa las sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyas pa'i cho ga khrigs su bkod pa ye shes chu rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (395)༄༅// klong sde rdo rje zam pa las sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyas pa'i cho ga khrigs su bkod pa ye shes chu rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so//

(396)༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī he ru kā ya/ brda' dang tshul bzhi'i gnad kyis dus thung ngur// 'od skur grol byed mchog gsang a ti'i lam// ston mdzad rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dpal chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal// smin byed thabs tshul rgyas bsdus ji snyed pas// nam yang mi skrun brda thabs byin rlabs kyis// dbang rnon skad cig grol byed rdzogs pa che'i// bka' srol bdud rtsi'i yang zhun btung bar byos so// klong sde rna brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa gsum pa smin pa grol bar byed pa sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyas par bya ba la don gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po dkyil 'khor dang rdzas bshams ba ni/ stegs gtsang mi'i steng bdud rtsi lngas chag chag btab ba la/ lte ba zlum skor rim pa lnga bskor ba'i dbus mthing ga /de rgyab ljang gu/ de rgyab ser po/ de rgyab dmar po/ de rgyab dkar po/ de'i phyi la chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng dmar po/ 'og mthing ga gzhi ser po bya/ chos 'byung zur drug gi rtse mor rdo rje ser bo bri ba'ang yod pas de ltar na chos 'byung gi phyi la zlum skor yangs pa bya/ de rgyab zlum skor rim pa gsum gyi dang po nyi dkyil dmar/ gnyis pa zla ba dkar/ gsum (397)pa sna tshogs pad+ma bri/ de rgyab gru bzhi rim pa gnyis bcad pa'i nang ma shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ de rgyab mu ran shar dmar/ lho ljang*/ nub dkar/ byang mthing ga can gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ de'i dbus su khri'u la 'bru yis bkang ba'i snod du rin po che'i bum pa bri bzang chu dang nyer lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang ba lam gul chings kha dog lnga ldan gu gul gyis bdug /sum+bha ni'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la bzhag /de'i steng ka pā la dum bu gcig pa'i nang sin+dhu ras byugs pa la chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar oṃ/

rtsibs drug la/ ā oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ ham̐ zhes pa'i 'bru drug mgo nang bstan du bris ba'i nang 'chang dang chos sman skyar bas bkang ba'i khar me long sin+dhu ra brdal ba la// chos 'byung sngags bcas snga ma ltar bris pas bkab pa'i steng byang sems dkar dmar gyi ril bu bzhag la dar dkar dmar gyis dgab/ de la ril bu ni/ byang sems dkar po/ cong zhi/ gangs tig cu gang*/ dkar po gcig thub/ kar rnams cha mnyam sbyar ba dkar po dang*/ byang sems dmar po/ sin+dhu ra/ me tog dmar po/ pad rag sogs rin po che dmar po/ 'bru dmar po/ bu ram rnams sbyar ba dmar po ste gnyis ka mar gyis ril bu dril ba da byid/ mchan/ slob ma'i grangs mnyam (398)byas la dkar po dang dkar dang de rgyab dar dmar du dril/ dmar po dar dmar dang de rgyab dkar pos dril la bzhag /rgyab mdun gang bder/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi gtor ma/ mkha' 'gro la gtor ma gsum sha khrag rtsi sman/ dkar mngar gyis brgyan pa'am las byang du bshad pa ltar dang*/ 'bru mar/ rtsi mar/ zhun chen gyi mar me mtshan thub gsum/ nyer spyod lnga rnams kyis mtha' bskor/ gzhan yang dam rdzas/ tshe bum/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang bris pa'i tshul shing*/ sgom thag /sgom rten/ las bum/ cod pan rnams dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ mchod gtor sogs nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bya'o/ byin 'bebs kyi dus su mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i spos sbyor gal che bas gzhung du 'byung ba ltar 'grub na legs so/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis// byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ las byang gi dbur bkod pa ltar phyi nang gi rgya mtsho khrus lung dang*/ sgo gsum las kyi spyod pa sngon du btang la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su gu ser po/ gu lang maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ de'i steng du paṃ yig kha dog lnga pa/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ sna tshogs pad+ma/ a dkar po/ a tsan+da/ maṇ+ḍal/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

ma dmar po/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi dbus su chos 'byung bsnol ma dmar po/ de'i nang du sa mthing ga /ba tiṣ+ṭha ba ti sngon po'i gdan/ de'i steng ba ti dmar po/ ba ti tiṣ+ṭha/ ba ti dmar po'i gdan/ de'i steng du bh+rūṃ yig /bh+rūṃ tiṣ+ṭha/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan ge sar dang bcas pa de dag gi shar phyogs su ke dkar po/ ke ke ru maṇ+ḍal/ ke ru dkar po'i zhing khams/ lho phyogs su baim mthing ga bai ḍūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ bai ḍūr+yasngon po'i zhing khams/ nub phyogs su paṃ dmar po/ pad+ma rā ga maṇ+ḍal/ pad rag dmar po'i zhing khams/ byang phyogs su maṇ+ḍi ljang gu// (399)in+d+ra ni la maṇ+ḍal/ in+d+ra nī la ljang gu'i zhing khams su gyur/ gnyis pa rdzas byin gyis brlab pa la gsum las bum pa byin rlabs ni/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi pad+ma ge sar gyi steng du rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du oṃ yig kha dog lnga ldan/ thig le mthing ga /zla tshes dkar po/ na ro ser po/ a dmar po/ 'a ljang gur yod pa de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par dbu'i gtsug tor las thon nas bum pa'i nang du thim par bsam/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes stong phrag bzla/ thod pa byin rlabs ni/ ka pā la yi nang du āḥdamar ser gcig gsal/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par ljags kyi dbang po las thon nas ka pā la'i nang thim par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥta/ zhes stong phrag bzla/ me long byin rlabs ni/ me long gi nang du haṃ dkar po zhig gsal/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pa thugs ka nas thon te me long gi steng du thim par bsam/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ haṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūṃ/ zhes stong phrag bzla'o// gnyis pa la'ang gnyis/ phrin las dang*/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga'o/ dang po ni las byang gi bgegs bsal ba dang*/ brgyud 'debs nas brtsam mthar chags su btang*/ dkyil 'khor bdag mdun dbyer med snang srid gzhir bzhengs su bskyed/ gzhung (400) gi bzlas pa grub nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum gyi snying po gong gsal so sor/ oṃ oṃ a a sarba ta thā ga ta ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes btags pa ci nus bzla zhing byin rlabs bsdu ba'i dmigs par bya/ tshe bum tshe dpag med du gsal ba las spro bsdu spyi ltar byas la/ oṃ pun+ye pun+ye ma hā pun+ye/ a pa ri mi ta/ a yu dz+nya na/ sarba ro pa sid+dhi swā hā/ zhes brgya stong ci 'grub bzla/ de nas gtor chog dang*/ tshogs mchod lhag ma yan chad grub par bya/ gdod nas 'khor 'das thams cad kun tu bzang mo'i klong chen gcig tu rdzogs pa'i lta ba'i gding bskyed pa las spros bcas kyi bdag 'jug mi dgos so// gnyis pa byin rlabs kyi cho ga la spyi don bco lngar bshad pa'i dang po rgyud sbyong ba ni/ khrus kyi bum pas slob ma rnams phyi rol tu khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad cing nang du zhugs nas srung 'khor bsgom/ skyabs 'gro dang khyad par sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sngon du ma thob pa yin na skyabs sems sdom chog lugs 'dir zur du 'byung ba nyid gal che bas nges par phog /de dag thob zin pa la skabs 'dir mdo bsdus tsam bya ste/ de la khyed rang rnams theg pa chen po'i yang rtse bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la dang po thun mong gi lam du rgyud sbyong ba gal che bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o// snyam pa dang*/

rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams re re bzhin gsal 'debs shing*/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa ldan pas 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ las byang ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs nas/ 'gro ba sgrol bar shogaḥ bar lan gsum brjod du (401) bzhugs/ gnyis pa gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ ras sam snam dkar gyi gdan la me tog gi tshom bu lngar bkod/ lag tu rdo rje 'jur bcug la/ de ltar rgyud rnam par dag par byas pa'i slob ma nyid gnyis pa dbang stegs kyi gdan la bzhag par mos shig /'di ni rdo rje'i lam mchog ste// skal ldan 'bad pa med par grol// bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni// chos dang chos nyid bsgom par gyis/ zhes pas gdan la bzhag go / gsum pa rdo rje rtse mo'i dkyil 'khor gnyan por zhug phyin chad dam tshig gi gnas las 'das na phung bar 'gyur cing srung na dngos grub mtha' dag 'thob par 'gyur bas dbang po'i tshul du mna' chu sbyin pa'i don nges par gyis shig /nang mchod sbyin la/ hūm̐/ 'di ni rdo rje dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na bsregs par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster// khyod kyis dam tshig chu 'di 'thung*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ha na ha na hūm̐/ zhes ngam chu blud/ bzhi pa rgyud la ye shes bskyed par bya ba lags te// ye shes 'di ni ye shes che// ye shes dam pa yod med shes// ye shes ye shes khyad par shes// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces cod pan mgor bzhag /de nas sems bskyed gsal gdab cing lo rgyus mdor bsdus spro na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rigs kun khyab bdag kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal thob la gsan par zhu/

de la gsan bya dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa zhig mchis pa las skabs su babs pa 'di ni (402)snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bka' srol la theg pa rim pa dgur grags pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa nang dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa/ de la'ang thabs dang shes rab dang zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor gtsor bton pa'i dbang las ma hā a nu a ti ste yo ga rnam pa gsum las 'dir thams cad kyi yang rtse a ti yo ga /de la'ang phyi sems sde/ nang klong sde/ gsang ba man ngag gi sde dang gsum du bzhugs pa las 'dir chos thams cad chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las nam yang 'dar med pa ston pa klong gi sde yin// 'di la rgyud lung man ngag gi rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing*/ de dag las phal mo che zhig 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa rig 'dzin grub pa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan slob dpon chen po shrī seng ha las/ rnam snang sprul pa'i lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa nas bka' ba mang du spyad nas gsan te klong chen rab 'byams rgyal po'i rgyud la sogs pa bod du'ang bsgyur/ lo tsā ba nyid kyang 'ja' lus kyi grub mthar gshegs shing gdams ngag spang mi pham mgon po la chig brgyud du gnang bas des mtshon brgyud pa lnga'i bar du 'ja' lus su gshegs pa sha stag byung*/ de las kyang gdod ma'i btsan sa zin pa'i grub thob kyi brgyud ba bar ma chad pa las byon pa'i rna brgyud rdo rje zam pa las dbang gi cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du bzhugs pa las sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs su grags pa'i cho ga rgyas pa bgyi ba la bdag nyid kyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams ma tshang ba med pa grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul bzhug lnga pa gsol ba gdab ba ni/ slob dpon dkyil (403)'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer ma mchis pa la mi phyed dang ba'i gdung shugs drag pos thal mo me tog dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos/

slob dpon dag ni dpal chen po// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag ni tshul chen snod yin te/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum du gdab bo/ drug cu gnang ba rtsal zhing skal ba 'bri ba lags te/ rigs kyi bu khyod gang la dga'/ zhes pa'i lan gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag ni bde ba chen po'i skal bzang la dga'/ zhes lan gdab bo/ bdun pa las gyi rdo rje'i phyag gi rdo rje la bzung ste dkyil 'khor gyi nang du gzhug par mos shig / rdo rje lag tu 'jur bcug la/ /bu 'dir shog cig theg chen don// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// dkyil 'khor chen po la gnas pa'i// pho brang gzhal yas dam pa 'dir// phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur gyi// bu yi dbang mchog thob par shog / ces dal du gzhug go / brgyad pa rdo rje'i dam tshig 'bog pa la lags pas 'di la gsan 'tshal// rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya// bsgom bya lha dang sgom byed mi// rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya// dang po rnam pa gsum yin te// lus kyi lha dang ngag gi sngags// yid kyi brda la blta ba'o// gnyis pa la ni rnam pa gsum// seng ge dkar mo'i sha mi za// za ma tog du zas ma btso// gnam lcags dur mo'i kha mi brdab// ces gsungs te/ de'ang spyir theg pa'i rtse rgyal 'dir 'jug pa la bslab pa'i mtha' drug dang ldan par dgos te/ gzhi dam tshig gis bzung*/ thag lta bas bcad/ la spyod pas dor/ nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis (404)blang*/ rim pa dbang gis bgrod/ don man ngag gis bsgrub pa rnams tshang dgos pa lags/ de la thog mar thams cad kyi gzhi dang rtsa bar gyur pa dam tshig la'ang spros na rgya che'ang*/ 'dir man ngag gi rim pas mdor bsdus te/ bsgom lha'i ngos nas bzhag pa dang*/ sgom byed mi'i ngos las nas bzhag pa gnyis su bstan/ dang po la lus kyis lha bar ma chad par bsgom pa mtshan ma dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor/

dag gis sngags rgyun chad med par bzla ba 'phro bsngags kyi rnal 'byor/ yid kyis brda bzhi'i gnad yengs med du sgom pa zab pa chos nyid kyi rnal 'byor te sku gsum gyi rnal 'byor la yod pa snying rje'i dam tshig dang med pa chos nyid kyi dam tshig gnyis kyang 'du ba yin/ gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i rgyud las mdor bsdus pa'i dam tshig nyi shu tham pa nyid gtso bo gsum du bsdus pa ste/ rdo rje slob dpon la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas ma gus pa skad cig mi bya zhing sgo gsum gyi mnyes pa sgrub pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi yum la mi spyad pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa mched lcam nang 'thabs mi byed pa ste rtsa ba gsum la yan lag bcu bdun po rnams kyang blang dor phyed par byas nas bsrung mtshams tshul bzhin du bya dgos so// dgu pa sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa yin pas lus bde lugs su bag phebs pa dang*/ sems gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di rnams rtse gcig bsgom par zhu// spyi bo'i steng du 'khor lo ni// gser las grub pa'i rtsib brgyad pa// yi ge oṃ gyis mtshan par bsgom// lce yi steng du pad+ma ni// pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la// ze'u 'bru āḥyis mtshan par bsgom// snying gar rdo rje rgya gram ni// mthing ga'i lte ba hūm̐ gis (405)brgyan/

ces pa rnams shin tu gsal ba la sems gtod la 'bru gsum brjod par bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod du gzhug /de la sems zin pa dang*/ de ni rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags so// bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags bstan pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ spyi gtsug dhū ti'i nang na dmar// yi ge nyaṃ ni mgor mthur 'phyang*// dkar la 'tsher ba bsgom par bya// lte ba'i nang du a dmar po// dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar ba la// me dmar bzhin du 'bar ba las// spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi bab// rang lus bdud rtsis khengs par bsam pa la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtod cig ḍa dril sogs rol mo bsgrag / a haṃ zhes mang du brjod/ bzlas brjod las kyi sngags bstan pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar sgom shig /gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las// 'od zer mdun du 'phros pa las// ḍā ki ma ni gsum du gyur// bud med dmar mo gzhon sha can// gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// skra grol ba ti'i sham thabs can// ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāṃ ga /ral gri'i tshul du 'dzin pa'o// lo brgyad pa yi na tshod la// gar ni khyug khyug mdzad par sgoms la ma yengs shig / ces byas la/ byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i rdzas bdug /rol mo'i sgra grag tu byas la/ oṃ badz+ra su laṃ ma laṃ ma ma ru ru tsit+ta a bi pra sa la/ zhes sngags mang du brjod pas/ lus la 'phar g.yo/ ngag la smra brjod/ sems la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ste byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags gsum 'byung bar gsungs so// bcu pa ye shes dbab pa'i rgyun sgo gsum la brtan par bya ba'i phyir byin rlabs rnam gsum bya ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod cig /khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu ni// oṃ ni btso ma gser lta bu// (406)de las 'od 'phros gyur pa las// gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa// lte ba oṃ gyis mtshan par bsgom// rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor bzhag la/

oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ s+t+waṃ/ khyod kyi lce yi steng du ni// āḥni dus mtha'i me lta bu/ de las 'od 'phros gyur pa las// pad+ma 'dab brgyad āḥs mtshan bsgom// rgya gram mgrin bar bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi shiñtsa mi s+t+waṃ/ khyod kyi snying ga'i gnas su ni// hūm̐ sngon rgya gram gcig bsam ste// de las 'od 'phros gyur pa las// lcags kyi rdo rje rgya gram la// lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsgom// rgya gram snying gar bzhag la sngags gong bzhin brjod/ me tog lag tu gtad la/ me tog 'di nyid khyod rang gi tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i rigs gang yin pa'i lha la phog par shog cig snyam pa'i mos 'dun rtse gcig pas 'dor ba zhu/ zhes dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu la 'dor du gzhug /de ltar dor ba'i me tog dbus su phog nas sangs rgyas rigs/ shar du rdo rje// lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du las kyi rigs su nges pa yin pas so so'i rigs kyi he ru ka nyid gtso bor lhag pa'i lha zung zhig /de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la rtsa ba dbang bzhi/ so so'i rjes 'brel bcas 'gyur ba las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang gi slad du khyed rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su phyag rgya lnga yi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du 'khod pa la/ 'di rnams 'grub na dngos su de ltar bshams/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dbyer med pas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis bkang bas dbang bskur ba rigs lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga'i dbang chen yongs su rdzogs pa thob par mos shig /rnam bum thogs la/ hūm̐// dbang bskur 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas (407)kun gyi bum pa'i dbang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi phyag rgya'i dbang*// sangs rgyas kun tu dbang bsgrub phyir// sku khyod la ni dbang bskur gyis// bu yi dbang mchog thob par shog

/ bum pa mgo bo'i gnas lngar bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃḥ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rigs rnam pa lnga'i dbang thob par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /rin po che'i rigs kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /pad+ma'i rigs kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /las kyi rigs kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / slar yang gnas lngar bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha oṃ/ badz+ra ka la sha hūm̐/ rat+na ka la sha trāṃ/ pad+ma ka la sha hrīḥ karma ka la sha āḥ sku rnam pa lnga'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /sprul pa sku'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /chos kyi sku'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /gsang ba'i sku'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / yang gnas lngar bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni oṃ/ badz+ra lo tsa ni hūm̐/ rat+na lo tsa ni trām̐/ pad+ma lo tsa ni hrīḥ karma lo tsa ni aḥ ye shes rnam pa lnga'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang ldan par gyur cig /me long lta bu'i ye shes dang ldan par gyur cig /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang ldan par gyur cig /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes dang ldan par gyur cig /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang ldan par gyur cig /gzung ba rang bzhin med pa sku'i dbang thob par (408)gyur cig /'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa gsung gi dbang thob par gyur cig /de nyid gang du yang ma grub pa thugs kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / zhes bum dbang bskur la bum pas khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi khrus gsol ba// ye shes chu bo khrus kyi rdzing*// bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam shing*// bkra shis bum pa spyi blug bzang*// dbang bskur thams cad 'dir gsol cig

/dbang bskur 'di ni rdo rje che// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang ba gsum las byung ba yi// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin par bya// phung po lnga ni rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs lnga ni sbyong bar byed// ye shes lnga ni ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan sku yi dbang bskur ro/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi s+t+waṃ s+t+wa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa mi s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi s+t+waṃ/ zhes khrus bya zhing bum chu blud/ gnyis pa gsang dbang gi don du dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i thig le bkod pa'i steng du 'khod pa la/ ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang bas dbang bskur bas sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi dbang chen yongs su rdzogs pa thob par mos shig / ka pā la'i bdud rtsi sogs spyi bo sogs gnas gsum du rim par bzhag la/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir gsol cig /hūm̐// rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyu drug sems can kun bsgral phyir// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi ste// bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang (409)bskul gyis// lce yi dam tshig rdo rje las// rdo rje can gyi oṃ bsgom ste// bdud rtsi lnga ru byin brlabs nas// zos pas byang chub mchog thob shog /kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje las// rdo rje can gyi āḥbasgom ste// bdud rtsi 'bru lngas byin brlabs nas// zos pas byang chub mchog thob shog /wak+ka sid+dhiḥ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje las// rdo rje can gyi hūm̐ bsgom ste// bdud rtsi 'bru lngas byin brlabs nas// zos pas dngos grub mchog thob shog /tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/

sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob par gyur cig /gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob par gyur cig /thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob par gyur cig / de nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi blud pa ni/ rdo rje ka pā la yi khar bzhag ste/ hūm̐// rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// rdo rje rgyal po rab tu bzang*// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// dag pa'i bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// bu khyod la ni dbang bskur bas// bu yi blo gros 'di 'thung la// gzhan la smra bar ma byed cig /a la la ho/ zhes bdud rtsi lan gsum du sbyin/ gsum pa sher dbang bskur ba'i slad du khyed rang dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su byang sems dkar dmar gyi thig le'i maṇ+ḍal steng du 'khod pa la thabs dang shes rab thig le dkar dmar gyis dbang bskur bas sku gsung thugs bde ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang chen thob par mos shig / me long ril bu bcas spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// byang sems thig ler rab sbyar nas// dag cing gsal la dri ma med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// 'di la yang dag ngos bzung med// bu khyod la ni dbang bskur bas// bu yi (410)dbang mchog thob par shog /sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rā ga ya haṃ/ sarba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dzaḥdhu pe pra be sha /hūm̐ puṣ+pe ā we sha /baṃ dī pa su khi ni/ hoḥghan+dhe tsit+ta hoḥ kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ byang sems thig le dkar po rnam par dag pa ni zla ba shar ba lta bu'i dbang thob par gyur cig /byang sems thig le dmar po rnam par dag pa ni nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i dbang thob par gyur cig / ces brjod la ril bu dkar dmar lce thog tu bzhag / sku bde ba'i mchog dang ldan par gyur cig /a la la ho/ gsung bde ba'i mchog dang ldan par gyur cig /a la la ho// thugs bde ba'i mchog dang ldan par gyur cig

/a la la ho/ zhes byang sems thig le'i dbang bskur ro// de dag gi mtha' rten du bcu gcig pa bkra shis tshe'i dbang bskur ba ni/ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud 'dus pa'i bum pa khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing dbang bskur bas// bum pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs// lus thams cad gang*/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang rdo rje lta bu'i srog thob par sgoms shig / tshe bum mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ skal ldan dbang mchog lha yi lung*// bdud rtsi gang rgya sman gyi lung*// rin chen zla gam dbang gi lung*// rat+na karma tshe yi lung rin chen sna lnga'i bum pa ru// rdo rje tshe yi bkang nas kyang*// rin chen brgyan gyis klubs nas kyang*// bu yi spyi bor dbang bskur bas// bu khyod tshe dbang gnas par shog /oṃ bruṃ hūm̐ bruṃ trāṃ bruṃ hrīḥbruṃ ā:bruṃ/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyis bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ rigs kyi bu 'di la rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ tshe dbang du gyur cig /tshe dbang phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /skye med kyi ye shes su gyur cig /(411)'chi med kyi bdud rtsir gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /mi shig pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig ces sogs shis pa brjod/ bcu gnyis pa zhing khams bstan pa 'di bzhin du nges 'tshal/ hūm̐// shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khang*// de'i nang rdo rje'i gdan bting ste// badz+ra he ru ka yi dbang bskur zhing*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba che// bde ba chen pos byin gyis rlobs// bde chen gyi ngang la spyod pa'o// lho phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khang*// de'i nang rdo rje'i gdan bting ste// rat+na he ru ka yi dbang bskur zhing*// rin chen mkha' 'gro bde ba che// bde ba chen pos byin gyis rlobs// bde chen gyi ngang la spyod pa'o// nub phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khang*// de'i nang rdo rje'i gdan bting ste// pad+ma he ru ka yi dbang bskur zhing*// pad+ma mkha' 'gro bde pa che// bde pa chen pos byin gyis rlobs// bde chen gyi ngang la spyod pa'o// byang phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khang*// de'i nang rdo rje'i gdan bting ste/

karmā he ru ka yi dbang bskur zhing*// las kyi mkha' 'gro bde ba che// bde ba chen pos byin gyis rlobs// bde chen gyi ngang la spyod pa'o// dbus phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khang*// de'i nang rdo rje'i gdan bting ste// bud+dha he ru ka yi dbang bskur zhing*// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bde ba che// bde ba chen pos byin gyis rlobs// bde (412)chen gyi ngang la spyod pa'o/ zhes zhing khams bstan pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa lam 'di'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang tshul bzhi'i sgom shing gtad pa yin pas 'di'i don nges par mdzod cig / tshul shing lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag bsten// de bzhin kun rdzobs bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// sgra dang tshig kun rdzob yin ni bden pa'o// don dam blo yi spyod yul min// tshul chen 'di la gnas par gyis// dharmā dha tu āḥ ye shes 'khyil pa rdo rje'i bum/ sogs tshul shing gi yi ge nyid tshar gcig bklag / de ltar ye shes kyi tshul/ chos nyid kyi tshul/ bde ba'i tshul/ dbyings kyi tshul te rnam pa bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin las nam yang ma g.yos par gyis shig /de nas dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang bskur ba'i slad du khyed rang dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su gur gum gyi chus rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i steng du 'khod par mos la snyan gtod par zhu// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*// skye ba med las thams cad skyes// skyes tsam nyid nas skye ba med// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang 'gags pa med las thams cad 'gags// skye 'gags med pa chos kyi dbyings// skye med kyi ngang du spyod pa'o// tshul chen 'di la gnas par gyis/ a ha ha// 'di ltar 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gang nas kyang ma skyes/

gang du'ang mi 'gag /gang la'ang gnas pa med pa ste gdod ma nyid nas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i don shes par mdzod la mnyam par zhog cig / ces dar gcig bzhag / de'i mtha' (413)rten du bcu gnyis pa sgom thag gtad pa yin pas 'di dang mi 'bral bar mdzod cig / sgom thag sbyin la/ hūm̐// byams dang snying rje'i thugs mnga' zhing*// sangs rgyas phrin las bsgrub bya'i phyir// bde ba'i bka' nan 'di bcings nas// chos dang chos nyid bsgom par gyis// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /dharmā dhā tu a/ bco lnga pa sgom rten 'di la brten nas lus kyi gnad dang ldan pas chos nyid kyi don sgom par gyis shig / sgom rten lag g.yon du gtad la/ hūm̐// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tsho ba rig 'dzin chos sku'i gdung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa bsgrub bya'i phyir// bde ba'i lus la rab brten nas// chos kyi dbyings nas ma g.yos phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /dharmā dhā tu a/ de nas dbang bskur thams cad kyi snying po brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs rim par 'jug pa'i ye shes 'pho ba'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rtsa ba brgyud par bcas pa'i thugs rgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'od kyi gong bu zhig 'phros nas khyed rang gi snying gar thim par bsam la thugs yid dbyer med du bsres la rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i ngang du zhog cig /

slob dpon bzhengs te phyag spyi bor bzhag la/ a ha ho wi/ zhes brjod/ brda de'i don ni// a ni skye med mi rtog brda// ha ni 'gag med gsal ba'i brda// ho ni gnyis su med pa'i brda// wi ni dbyer mi phyed pa'i brda// spros bral don gyi rnal 'byor te// de kho na nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'o/ zhes brda sprad/ 'di dag gi don gsal ba byin rlabs 'brid bsdus las 'byung ba'o/ /bcu drug pa bka' srung mkha' 'gro ma la las kyi gnyer (414)gtad pa ste/ 'bar ba me'i gdong can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis ji ltar bgos pa'i phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par mos shig / gtor ma lag tu gtad la/ /'bar ba'i gdong can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// zhing las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ming po rdo rje mched lcam la// grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun ma bcad// sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dgra rnams// pha rol 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis med par mdzod// gang sgrub pa la mi gnas gyur pa ni// mkha' 'gro ma yis bka' chad dbab bar 'gyur ro// mkha' la spyod ma'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// mngal las skyes kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ming po rdo rje mched lcam la// grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun ma bcad// sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dgra rnams// pha rol 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis med par mdzod// gang sgrub pa la mi gnas gyur pa na// mkha' 'gro ma yis bka' chad dbab par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i bden tshig dbyangs su len/ me tog man+dā ra ba'i char sil mar bsnyil bas dbang gi ye shes ma skyes pa skyes/

skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba sogs dge legs rtag pa dam pa'i snang ba rab tu spel par mos shig / zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs shis brjod rgyas par spel zhing me tog 'thor/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ dbang gi rjes ni/ (415)de dag rnams kyis theg pa rim pa dgu'i mthar thug bla na med pa a ti rdzogs pa chen po sde gsum las nang sgor klong sde'i smin byed rna brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rim pa tshul bzhin grub pa lags pas thun mong dang thun min ma yin pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum/ gtong rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba dge bsngo byas la slob ma rnams gyis/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog gtor ma gtong ba nas/ bsdu ldangs bsngo smon gyis bar phrin las su ji skad bshad pa ltar bya'o/ gdos bcas 'od kyi sku ru grol byed pa// dpal seng thugs bcud rnam snang lo tsā bas// dka' dgu'i btsal pa'i zab chos 'jig rten na// u dum wa ra'i dper mtshungs dkon pa'i phul// gang 'di'i nyams len tshul bzhin bgyid nus pa'i// skal bzang skye bo rgyun mi 'chad 'byon nas// lus can bye ba rdul snyed gzhi dbyings su// rnam grol phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /'di la 'dzing badz+ra pra bhas tshig bcad du bsdebs pa nyid las gsal byed kyi yig cha gzhan ma bzhugs/ yig rnying de'ang rtsa tho lta bur bsdus shing mchan bu'i dpe rgyun ma dag pa mang ba dang*// dengs dus tshul 'di 'dra go don phyag len zhun thar gcod mkhan med pa'i dpe mthong bon gyer mang bas/ zab chos kyi rgyud la phan bar re ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pas a ti'i rnal 'byor tsam bo ba pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub gnas chen bor gsal bar bkod pa dge legs 'phel/// /
